description: Auto-numbered item id. Not a plain field: it hangs 3 Property children off Field::Property, one of which (PrefixExpression) itself owns an Expression — the ONE place an Expression is Property-owned rather than ProcessDef- or Activity-owned.
notes: UNCAPTURED and deliberately omitted: the Expression's own Node-tree internals for a concatenate(...) call (unlike the binary infix "=" pattern in expression_branch.json / expression_goto_condition.json, which was captured 4 times). Only the Property->Expression wiring and the ExpressionStr mirror are grounded. Do not synthesize an Expression::Node list here — capture one from a builder-typed sequence-number prefix before writing it.

An Expression is NOT always a branch/loop condition: this is the third of three owner keys (ProcessDef=branch, Activity=goto loop, Property=this). Always branch on which key is present rather than assuming ProcessDef.
Padding's Value is a wire STRING ("0001"), and Step stores the owning Activity's id as its Value (stamped there by the builder, not something you choose independently).
The host Column for a SequenceNumber field is IsHidden:true and gets NO Permission nodes — hidden columns have no per-step visibility to set; do not count them as visibility-matrix gaps.

INFERRED, UNVERIFIED: each Property's scalar owner back-ref ("Field": "Field_Sample01") is inferred from the convention seen on other node families (e.g. a FieldMapping owns its Property via a scalar owner key) — no raw capture of a real UI-built SequenceNumber field exists anywhere in research/ to confirm this specific key name, and this whole shape's source_capture is CLAUDE.md prose rather than a saved JSON capture. Treat the "Field" key on Property_Sample01/02/03 as a plausible-by-convention placeholder, not a captured fact, until a builder-typed sequence-number field is captured.
